question: Did the new onboarding flow improve seven-day activation for eligible July signups versus June?

included: Eligible June and July signups with a known platform
excluded: Signups without seven days of observation

comparison: July new-flow cohort versus June prior-flow cohort, segmented by web and mobile

transformations.logic: activated_at is within seven complete days after signup_date

metrics.name: July web activation
metrics.formula: activated eligible July web users / eligible July web users

qualityFindings.issue: 2.1% of eligible rows lack a platform
qualityFindings.disposition: Excluded from platform split and retained in overall sensitivity check

findings.statement: July web activation is higher than June, but the observational comparison does not establish causality.
